title: oxyotis sedoides
intro: Oxyotis sedoides, commonly known as "sand tea", is a type of succulent plant that is native to South Africa. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxyotis sedoides include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
